what: The Builder's tuning of the rise. cover: how much wider than its window the camera sees at each key. settlePerFrame: the rate the climb has on the titan frame (natural log of the width, per film frame). holdPerFrame: the steady rate it eases down to and then keeps until the cut to black, so the hold is never a still. settleFrames: how long that easing takes. holdCentre: where the middle of the frame ends the hold, in px of the master: the middle of the land's bounding box, so the body ends with clear space on every side. lakeShorePx and lakeDeepPx: the half axes of the lake's amber ring and of its deep water, in px of the master.
